components.name: MatToolbar
components.description: Application toolbar for grouping navigation actions.
components.accessibility: Use a descriptive toolbar label and expose interactive controls within the toolbar.
components.usage: Place the theme selector at the right side of the existing top navigation toolbar.

components.name: MatIconButton
components.description: Native button styled to contain a single icon and perform an action.
components.accessibility: Icon-only buttons require a meaningful accessible name; the documented touch target is 48 by 48.
components.usage: Use as the menu trigger, aligned to the right of the navigation toolbar.

components.name: MatIcon
components.description: Renders registered SVG or font icons within Angular Material controls.
components.accessibility: An icon inside an interactive control is decorative; the parent button must provide an accessible name.
components.usage: Reuse icons registered by the application; add a local SVG only when the existing icon set has no suitable glyph.

components.name: MatMenu
components.description: Floating panel that presents a list of actions or options.
components.accessibility: Uses the menu role, keyboard navigation, focus management and focus restoration to the trigger; provide an accessible label.
components.usage: Attach the menu to the theme icon button and place menu items below the trigger.
components.avoid: Do not place interactive controls other than menu items inside the menu.

components.name: MatMenuItem
components.description: Keyboard-operable action or choice inside a Material menu.
components.accessibility: Use descriptive text; indicate the selected theme with text or an icon, not color alone.
components.usage: Provide one item each for light, dark and system theme choices.

components.name: MatButtonToggleGroup
components.description: Group of mutually exclusive toggle buttons.
components.usage: Use only for mutually exclusive view modes; not for the requested dropdown menu.

components.name: MatFormField
components.description: Container for form controls with labels and outlines.
components.usage: Use for form inputs; it is not the theme selection menu.

patterns.name: Angular Material light and dark color scheme
patterns.description: Angular Material generates semantic color tokens for light and dark schemes from one palette.
patterns.usage: Use theme-type color-scheme with the existing Azure palette, then set the root color-scheme to light, dark or light dark according to the selected mode.
